1//! Ported from <https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/src/core/calculate_sha256.js>.

3use alloc::vec;
4
5const K: [u32; 64] = [
6    0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5, 0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3,
7    0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174, 0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
8    0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967, 0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13,
9    0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85, 0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
10    0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3, 0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208,
11    0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
12];
13
14#[inline]
15const fn rotr(x: u32, n: u32) -> u32 {
16    x.rotate_right(n)
17}
18
19#[inline]
20const fn ch(x: u32, y: u32, z: u32) -> u32 {
21    (x & y) ^ (!x & z)
22}
23
24#[inline]
25const fn maj(x: u32, y: u32, z: u32) -> u32 {
26    (x & y) ^ (x & z) ^ (y & z)
27}
28
29#[inline]
30const fn sigma_0(x: u32) -> u32 {
31    rotr(x, 2) ^ rotr(x, 13) ^ rotr(x, 22)
32}
33
34#[inline]
35const fn sigma_1(x: u32) -> u32 {
36    rotr(x, 6) ^ rotr(x, 11) ^ rotr(x, 25)
37}
38
39#[inline]
40const fn little_sigma_0(x: u32) -> u32 {
41    rotr(x, 7) ^ rotr(x, 18) ^ (x >> 3)
42}
43
44#[inline]
45const fn little_sigma_1(x: u32) -> u32 {
46    rotr(x, 17) ^ rotr(x, 19) ^ (x >> 10)
47}
48
49pub(crate) fn calculate(data: &[u8]) -> [u8; 32] {
50    let mut h = [0x6a09e667_u32, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];
51
52    let bit_len = data.len() as u64 * 8;
53    let padded_len = (data.len() + 9).div_ceil(64) * 64;
54    let mut padded = vec![0_u8; padded_len];
55
56    padded[..data.len()].copy_from_slice(data);
57    padded[data.len()] = 0x80;
58
59    let len_bytes = bit_len.to_be_bytes();
60    padded[padded_len - 8..].copy_from_slice(&len_bytes);
61
62    for chunk in padded.chunks_exact(64) {
63        let mut w = [0_u32; 64];
64
65        for (i, word_bytes) in chunk.chunks_exact(4).enumerate() {
66            w[i] = u32::from_be_bytes([word_bytes[0], word_bytes[1], word_bytes[2], word_bytes[3]]);
67        }
68
69        for i in 16..64 {
70            w[i] = little_sigma_1(w[i - 2]).wrapping_add(w[i - 7]).wrapping_add(little_sigma_0(w[i - 15])).wrapping_add(w[i - 16]);
71        }
72
73        let [mut a, mut b, mut c, mut d, mut e, mut f, mut g, mut h_var] = h;
74
75        for i in 0..64 {
76            let temp1 = h_var.wrapping_add(sigma_1(e)).wrapping_add(ch(e, f, g)).wrapping_add(K[i]).wrapping_add(w[i]);
77            let temp2 = sigma_0(a).wrapping_add(maj(a, b, c));
78
79            h_var = g;
80            g = f;
81            f = e;
82            e = d.wrapping_add(temp1);
83            d = c;
84            c = b;
85            b = a;
86            a = temp1.wrapping_add(temp2);
87        }
88
89        h[0] = h[0].wrapping_add(a);
90        h[1] = h[1].wrapping_add(b);
91        h[2] = h[2].wrapping_add(c);
92        h[3] = h[3].wrapping_add(d);
93        h[4] = h[4].wrapping_add(e);
94        h[5] = h[5].wrapping_add(f);
95        h[6] = h[6].wrapping_add(g);
96        h[7] = h[7].wrapping_add(h_var);
97    }
98
99    let mut result = [0_u8; 32];
100    for (i, &hash_word) in h.iter().enumerate() {
101        let bytes = hash_word.to_be_bytes();
102        result[i * 4..(i + 1) * 4].copy_from_slice(&bytes);
103    }
104
105    result
106}

108#[cfg(any())]
109mod tests {
110    use super::*;
111    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
112
113    #[cfg(any())]
114    fn correctness() {
115        let test_cases = [b"" as &[u8], b"a", b"abc", b"Hello, World!", &[0xde, 0xad, 0xbe, 0xef]];
116
117        for test_case in test_cases {
118            let our_result = calculate(test_case);
119            let expected = Sha256::digest(test_case);
120            assert_eq!(our_result, expected.as_slice(), "Failed for input: {test_case:?}");
121        }
122    }
123}
